ModMetaData.name: MapGen AI
ModMetaData.author: Choco
ModMetaData.description: Describe your map in plain words and MapGen AI builds it, with live Map Preview. Edits keep what you built: add, move, or resize parts of the map, and undo one request at a time. Get up to three suggested maps drawn by Map Preview, or answer a few preference questions first (no AI calls). Also: exact or natural shapes, partial fills, positioned ruins and ancient dangers, local roads with automatic wooden bridges, and natural lakes. RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony and Map Preview. Set your AI provider and API key in Mod Settings. Image input is temporarily disabled.
